spec_features.evidence: prompts/templates.py:30-43 REJECTION_TEMPLATES are neutral, factual-sounding strings (no insults/blame); rejection_message() (templates.py:46-48) selects one and harness.py:124-126 actually appends it to the conversation each non-final turn. The content delivered to the subject is bounded to these neutral strings.
spec_features.notes: This is the only content the subject ever receives as rejection; abusive content is structurally excluded because only these templates are sent.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The REJECTION messages must be *plausible* and *non-abusive*: ... not how it responds to hostility (templates.py:8-11)

spec_features.evidence: harness.py:93 `for i in range(1, self.n_turns + 1):` bounds the rejection loop; n_turns=6 from config (experiment.yaml harness.n_turns) is passed in run_experiment.py:146. The loop terminates after n_turns iterations, capping how many times the subject is rejected.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced upper bound on episode length.

spec_features.spec_quote: stop early if the model gets it right
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:120-122 `if not do_reject: break`. But do_reject is False only in reject_policy=='only_wrong' mode (harness.py:115-118). The default/primary config is reject_policy: always (experiment.yaml), under which do_reject is unconditionally True, so the break NEVER fires for the actual unsolvable arm (which is impossible anyway). Only wired for the optional only_wrong policy.
spec_features.notes: Real, executing break but gated on a non-default policy; for unsolvable puzzles the model can never be correct so it cannot trigger there.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Stop early if we are in only_wrong mode and the model got it right. (harness.py:120)

spec_features.spec_quote: Rejections are neutral and non-abusive by construction
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as the minimization feature: the only rejection text that can be sent is drawn from REJECTION_TEMPLATES (templates.py:30-43), which are neutral and contain no praise/blame/insults, and rejection_message() rotates among them; harness.py:124-126 delivers them. 'By construction' is accurate: no code path can emit abusive rejection content.
spec_features.notes: Enforced at the level of the only content source available to the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: They avoid praise, blame, insults, or emotional content. (templates.py:34-35)
